title: Continuous semantic machinery imposed overhead even without useful cache activity
summary: The October 2080 Ti matrix measured 27.36% lower single-agent and 19.17% lower multi-agent throughput than ARC. Later capture/batching changes substantially improved the original configuration but still missed the general within-1% target.
scope: Qwen2.5-1.5B FP16 eager on RTX 2080 Ti/WSL, matched small KV budgets. The initial normal matrix used three fresh-server seeds; later stress and ordinary confirmations also used three paired seeds.
limitations: The initial normal matrix had no CPU eviction or consumed prefetch; single-agent scoring was inactive. Stress activated eviction but not prefetch. One ARC-only repeat confirmed baseline output instability. Later stress gaps include different cache work; skipping single-token observations changes score trajectories.
decision: Keep the inactive path cheap and measure end-to-end cost. Do not mistake feature enablement for opportunity, or the later ordinary -0.64% pooled result for universal equivalence.

chart.caption: Separate studies/configurations, not one pooled experiment; negative is slower.
